## Purpose

Describe the problem this PR solves and why the change is needed.

## What changed

Summarize the implementation. Keep claims specific and evidence-backed.

## How it was tested

List the commands, fixtures, benchmarks, or CI jobs used to validate the change.

## Semantic / evidence impact

For SWOS Prose, research, citation, or reasoning changes, describe any effect on claims, evidence, citations, qualifiers, uncertainty, attribution, scope, causality, or epistemic status. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My commits include the required DCO `Signed-off-by:` line.
- [ ] This PR targets `main` unless there is an explicit reason not to.
- [ ] I added or updated tests/fixtures that prove the change works, where applicable.
- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks or documented why a check is intentionally skipped.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation, where applicable.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private data, or unlicensed/copyrighted source text.
- [ ] Any semantic-safety change includes an adversarial case or regression fixture.

## Reviewer focus

Call out anything the reviewer should attack specifically: false PASS cases, compatibility risk, schema migration, provider behavior, performance/cost, or unresolved uncertainty.
